SAMProxyMetadata.description: Smarter API Proxy Manifest - Metadata class.

annotations.description: Annotations, as in Kubernetes: a map of keys to string values that clients and integrations attach to a resource for their own purposes, e.g. to associate it with a resource in another system. A key is an optional DNS-subdomain prefix that names its owner, then a slash and a name of one or more slash-separated segments, e.g. 'acme.com/crm-account-id'. The prefix 'smarter.sh' and its subdomains are reserved for the Smarter platform. Values are strings: unquoted YAML scalars such as true, 42 or dates are converted to strings, and structured data belongs in a JSON string. All annotations together are limited to 256 KiB. The list of one-key maps of older manifests, e.g. [{'acme.com/crm-account-id': 'A-10042'}], is also accepted.
annotations.title: Annotations

description.description: The description for this resource. Be brief. Keep it under 255 characters.
description.title: Description

name.description: The camelCase name of the manifest resource
name.title: Name

tags.description: The tags of the manifest. Used for generic resource categorization and search. Example: ['tag1', 'tag2']
tags.title: Tags

version.description: The semantic version of the manifest. Example: 0.1.0
version.title: Version

SAMProxyMetadata.title: SAMProxyMetadata

allowedPaths.description: Proxy.spec.allowedPaths[list]: glob patterns of the paths, relative to baseUrl, that callers may use, e.g. chat/completions or models/*. Empty allows every path.
allowedPaths.title: Allowedpaths

apiKey.description: Proxy.spec.apiKey[str]: the name of the Secret that contains the provider's API key. It must belong to, or be shared with, the manifest's owner. Defaults to the Provider's API key.
apiKey.title: Apikey

auth.description: Proxy.spec.auth[object]: how the provider expects its API key. Defaults to Authorization: Bearer.

baseUrl.description: Proxy.spec.baseUrl[str]: the base URL of the provider's API, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1/. Defaults to the Provider's base URL.
baseUrl.title: Baseurl

headers.description: Proxy.spec.headers[dict]: other HTTP headers that are added to every request, e.g. anthropic-version. They replace the caller's headers of the same name.
headers.title: Headers

isActive.description: Proxy.spec.isActive[bool]: inactive Proxy refuse every request.
isActive.title: Isactive

provider.description: Proxy.spec.provider[str]: the name of the Provider whose API the Proxy forwards to, e.g. openai. It must belong to, or be shared with, the manifest's owner.
provider.title: Provider

timeout.description: Proxy.spec.timeout[int]: the most seconds to wait for the provider's response.
timeout.title: Timeout

SAMProxySpecAuth.description: Spec.auth: how the provider expects its API key.

header.description: Proxy.spec.auth.header[str]: the HTTP header in which the provider expects its API key, e.g. Authorization (OpenAI), x-api-key (Anthropic) or x-goog-api-key (Google Gemini).
header.title: Header

scheme.description: Proxy.spec.auth.scheme[str]: the prefix of the API key in the header, e.g. Bearer. Empty or null for none, e.g. for x-api-key.
scheme.title: Scheme

SAMProxySpecAuth.title: SAMProxySpecAuth

SAMProxyStatus.description:
Smarter API Proxy Manifest - Status class.

Read only. Besides ownership, it reports where the Proxy is, and where it forwards to.

accountNumber.description: Proxy.status.accountNumber: The account owner of this Proxy. Read only.
accountNumber.title: Accountnumber

apiKeySecret.description: Proxy.status.apiKeySecret: The name of the Secret whose API key is added to requests: spec.apiKey, else the Provider's. None if there is none. Read only.
apiKeySecret.title: Apikeysecret

created.description: The date in which this resource was created. Read only.
created.title: Created

dependencies.description: dependencies[List]: The resources that depend on this resource, and that must be deleted, or stop referring to it, before it can be deleted. Lists only the resources that you can read. Read only.
dependencies.title: Dependencies

modified.description: The date in which this resource was most recently changed. Read only.
modified.title: Modified

recordLocator.description: recordLocator[String]: An optional identifier used to locate the resource record associated with this manifest. Read only.
recordLocator.title: Recordlocator

upstreamUrl.description: Proxy.status.upstreamUrl: The base URL of the provider's API, to which requests are forwarded: spec.baseUrl, else the Provider's. Read only.
upstreamUrl.title: Upstreamurl

url.description: Proxy.status.url: The URL of the Proxy's passthrough endpoint, to use as the base URL of the provider's SDK. Read only.
url.title: Url

username.description: Proxy.status.username: The Smarter user who created this Proxy. Read only.
username.title: Username
